sid_items_Gun_Margach_SG_description:
Origin: South Africa
Manufacturer: Hilton R. Walker

A 12-gauge combat shotgun recognizable by its Kalashnikov design, intended for engaging targets at short range or in confined spaces. Known for its effectiveness and lethality, it has replaced the Armsel Protecta for Russian riot control and infantry combat.

This version has been customized using aluminum and polymer components to reduce weight and improve overall ergonomics.
sid_items_Gun_Logarithm_SMG_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Kriss USA, Inc.

Invented by French engineer Renaud Kerbrat, the Vector uses an unconventional delayed blowback system to reduce recoil and muzzle climb by transferring energy downward rather than rearward. It is the ideal choice for law enforcement and military units seeking a controllable, compact weapon system for close quarter combat environments.

The previous owner of this weapon did some serious tuning, including adding a specialized barrel with an integrated sound moderator and longer handguard.
sid_items_Gun_Novator_AR_description:
Origin: Ukraine
Manufacturer: RPC Fort

A versatile Ukrainian-made assault rifle designed for precision and reliability in harsh conditions. Featuring a compact bullpup design, it offers excellent maneuverability without sacrificing barrel length or accuracy. With its balanced performance, modular capabilities, and rugged construction, the Fort-221 is a favored weapon for seasoned stalkers who value adaptability and dependability in any firefight.

Numerous modifications have been added to achieve increased efficiency for special missions inside and outside the Zone including the addition of a built-in sound moderator.
sid_items_GunMosina_SP_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: Tula Arms Plant (TOZ)

The M1891 is a bolt-action, internal magazine–fed military rifle used by the armed forces of the Russian Empire, the Soviet Union and various other states. It is one of the most mass-produced military bolt-action rifles in history, with over 37 million units produced since 1891. Despite its age, it has been used in various conflicts around the world up to the present day.
sid_questItemprototypes_SkifGun_descript:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Izhmash

This Soviet legacy is one of the best compact self-defense handguns available. Small, highly reliable, easy to use and easy to maintain, the Pistol Makarova was selected because of its simplicity, easy manufacturing, accuracy and reasonable stopping power.

Skif’s honorary PM. Every shot fired carries a haunting echo, stirring memories of dark nights and the suffocating dread of waiting for an enemy that never sleeps.
sid_items_Gun_SkifGun_HG_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Izhmash

This Soviet legacy is one of the best compact self-defense handguns available. Small, highly reliable, easy to use and easy to maintain, the Pistol Makarova was selected because of its simplicity, easy manufacturing, accuracy and reasonable stopping power.

Skif’s honorary PM. Every shot fired carries a haunting echo, stirring memories of dark nights and the suffocating dread of waiting for an enemy that never sleeps.
sid_items_Gun_Lummox_AR_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

The Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoi, is a gas-operated assault rifle developed by Russian small-arms designer Mikhail Kalashnikov. After more than seven decades since its creation, the AK and its variants remain one of the most popular and widely used firearms in the world due to their reliability under harsh conditions, low production cost, and ease of use. AKS rifles feature a downward-folding metal stock.

Stored in a hidden stash at the Water Tower, Valik Lummox never got the chance to make use of his assault rifle though you'd be surprised judging by its current condition.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ01_GunAK74_ST_:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

The Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoi, is a gas-operated assault rifle developed by Russian small-arms designer Mikhail Kalashnikov. After more than seven decades since its creation, the AK and its variants remain one of the most popular and widely used firearms in the world due to their reliability under harsh conditions, low production cost, and ease of use.

Stored in a hidden stash at the Water Tower, Valik Lummox never got the chance to make use of his assault rifle though you'd be surprised judging by its current condition.
sid_items_Gun_Unknown_AR_description:
Origin: Germany
Manufacturer: Heckler & Koch

Developed for United States special operations forces as a major product improvement of the M4, the HK416 uses the proprietary gas piston system found on the G36 and therefore does not introduce propellant gases and carbon fouling back into the weapon’s interior, making it the most reliable of any M4/M16 type weapons. The rifle has been combat-proven and has rightfully gained worldwide attention of military and law enforcement.

Found in the Poppy Fields, it appears that the previous owner either took poor care of their weapon or nature has taken its toll.
sid_questItemprototypes_SQ02_GunM16_ST_d:
Origin: Germany
Manufacturer: Heckler & Koch

Developed for United States special operations forces as a major product improvement of the M4, the HK416 uses the proprietary gas piston system found on the G36 and therefore does not introduce propellant gases and carbon fouling back into the weapon’s interior, making it the most reliable of any M4/M16 type weapons. The rifle has been combat-proven and has rightfully gained worldwide attention of military and law enforcement.

Found in the Poppy Fields, it appears that the previous owner either took poor care of their weapon or nature has taken its toll.
sid_items_Gun_SOFMOD_AR_description:
Origin: Germany
Manufacturer: Heckler & Koch

Developed for United States special operations forces as a major product improvement of the M4, the HK416 uses the proprietary gas piston system found on the G36 and therefore does not introduce propellant gases and carbon fouling back into the weapon’s interior, making it the most reliable of any M4/M16 type weapons. The rifle has been combat-proven and has rightfully gained worldwide attention of military and law enforcement.

A rifle assembled by a certain Freedom member to suit his specific needs. An excellent choice if you want a single gun for tackling all the challenges the Zone throws your way.
sid_items_Gun_S15_AR_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: TsKIB SOOA

A powerful bullpup assault rifle favored for its versatility and raw stopping power in the Zone. Chambered for 7.62×39mm rounds, it offers exceptional damage output, making it effective against both heavily armored targets and tough mutants. Compact and adaptable, the Groza can be equipped with a grenade launcher for added firepower. Its weight and recoil require practice to handle effectively, but in the hands of a skilled stalker, it’s a devastating tool for survival in close to mid-range engagements.

The 2A is an experimental model chambered in 5.45×39mm.
sid_items_Gun_Deadeye_HG_description:
Origin: Germany
Manufacturer: Heckler & Koch

Originally designed for the American market, the United States law enforcement and military provided much of the design criteria for the USP. Used by many police and special forces units worldwide, the Universal Self-Loading Pistol is known as an accurate and reliable handgun able to withstand extreme punishment and adverse conditions.

Crafted to order, this pistol is outfitted with sporting attachments. No one can ascertain how this rare piece found its way into the Zone, but the pistol still offers remarkable performance under harsh local conditions.
sid_items_Gun_Encourage_HG_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Tula Arms Plant (TOZ)

A compact, suppressed semi-automatic version of the APS pistol, designed for silent operations in hostile environments. Featuring a lightweight frame, it is chambered in 9x18mm Makarov and built for reliability in rugged conditions. The integral suppressor ensures reduced noise and muzzle flash, making it ideal for stealthy engagements. Widely used in the Zone by stalkers who prioritize concealment and tactical versatility, the APB is a favored sidearm for covert missions.

Awarded to Alexander Korshunov during his time as a lieutenant, this pistol boasts precise craftsmanship. The bolt bears an inscription: “Glory. Service. Honor.”
sid_items_Gun_Sbanger_HG_description:
Origin: Brazil
Manufacturer: Taurus International

A formidable revolver known for its immense stopping power and rugged reliability. This hand cannon is capable of taking down heavily armored foes or large mutants with a single well-placed shot, though its limited six-round capacity and slower reload time require careful ammo management.

Someone went the extra mile to chamber this revolver for special intermediate cartridges. The effort invested in this project is difficult to measure, but the outcome is undeniably impressive.
sid_items_Gun_GStreet_HG_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Military Armament Corp.

A compact, fully automatic submachine gun prized for its lightweight design and high rate of fire. Ideal for close-quarters combat, it excels in tight spaces and ambush scenarios where rapid firepower is critical. However, its small magazine capacity and limited range make it less effective in prolonged engagements or at a distance. A favored weapon among nimble stalkers and mercenaries, the Mac-10 is a reliable choice when firepower and mobility are paramount.

Modeled after gangster movies from the 80s and 90s, this customized MAC-10 may look impressive, but its practicality in the Zone remains questionable.
sid_items_Gun_Shakh_SMG_description:
Origin: West Germany
Manufacturer: Heckler & Koch

One of the most famous and widespread firearms of its class, the MP5's compactness, accuracy and reliability have made it a favorite of numerous militaries, law enforcement, intelligence and security organizations the world over. The A3 variant is fitted with a retractable metal stock further increasing the weapon's CQB capabilities.

The personal firearm of the Shah, the kingpin of the Brood, is a custom order from the Mainland, complete with an extended magazine. You won’t find another gun quite like this in all of Garbage!
sid_items_Gun_Spitter_SMG_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: KBP Instrument Design Bureau

Based on the Czechoslovak Skorpion vz.61, the OTs-02 is a blowback operated submachine gun used by the Russian Internal Affairs Ministry as a special purpose police weapon. Powered by free bolt recoil with shots fired from a closed bolt, the weapon's accuracy and rate of fire is surprisingly good, even under fully automatic fire. To further increase weapon stability, a folding stock is included that folds up on top of the receiver.

While most stalkers aren’t big fans of the OTs-02, this one clearly belonged to a true aficionado. Engraved on the side are the letters “SC,” likely the former owner's initials.
sid_items_Gun_Silence_SMG_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

The AKS-74U is a highly compact and versatile carbine designed for close-quarters engagements, delivering the stopping power of an assault rifle in a lightweight, portable package. Its shortened barrel and folding stock make it perfect for tight spaces, while retaining the durability and reliability AK-pattern weapons are known for. A favorite among stalkers for its balance of firepower and maneuverability, it excels in urban and indoor skirmishes.

A special forces variant of an assault rifle, this particular piece was owned by a stalker known as Bes.
sid_items_Gun_RatKiller_SMG_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: Izhmash

Developed at the request of the Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs for counter-terrorist and law enforcement units that needed a lightweight weapon capable of fast and accurate fire at close ranges. The Bizon is most notable for it's distinctive under-barrel helical magazine.

A PP-19 variant chambered for a different caliber. The body of this submachine gun boasts an urban camouflage paint job. It’s an absolute delight for shooting rats and rodents.
sid_items_Gun_Spitfire_SMG_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

The AKS-74U is a highly compact and versatile carbine designed for close-quarters engagements, delivering the stopping power of an assault rifle in a lightweight, portable package. Its shortened barrel and folding stock make it perfect for tight spaces, while retaining the durability and reliability AK-pattern weapons are known for. A favorite among stalkers for its balance of firepower and maneuverability, it excels in urban and indoor skirmishes.

A compact self-defense weapon combining the rate of fire of a machine gun with the accuracy typically found in assault rifles.
sid_items_Gun_Combatant_AR_description:
“Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

The Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoi, is a gas-operated assault rifle developed by Russian small-arms designer Mikhail Kalashnikov. After more than seven decades since its creation, the AK and its variants remain one of the most popular and widely used firearms in the world due to their reliability under harsh conditions, low production cost, and ease of use. AKS rifles feature a downward-folding metal stock.

Dmytro and I were just discussing a certain puzzle we’ve been working on in the Zone, but we can’t quite seem to get all the pieces to fit. Give me a hand, would you?”
sid_items_Gun_Drowned_AR_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

The Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoi, is a gas-operated assault rifle developed by Russian small-arms designer Mikhail Kalashnikov. After more than seven decades since its creation, the AK and its variants remain one of the most popular and widely used firearms in the world due to their reliability under harsh conditions, low production cost, and ease of use. AKS rifles feature a downward-folding metal stock.

After an unintentional swim, this assault rifle spent quite some time underwater. Despite its questionable appearance, the weapon continues to function without any issues.
sid_items_Gun_Decider_AR_description:
Origin: Ukraine
Manufacturer: RPC Fort

A versatile Ukrainian-made assault rifle designed for precision and reliability in harsh conditions. Featuring a compact bullpup design, it offers excellent maneuverability without sacrificing barrel length or accuracy. With its balanced performance, modular capabilities, and rugged construction, the Fort-221 is a favored weapon for seasoned stalkers who value adaptability and dependability in any firefight.

An early version of the Fort-221 that belonged to a worthy stalker. The previous owner clearly spared no expense on maintenance and upgrades.
sid_items_Gun_Merc_AR_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Tula Arms Plant (TOZ)

A specialized sniper rifle designed for stealth operations in the Zone. Lightweight and compact, the Vintorez is ideal for those favoring precision and discretion. Its effective range and armor-piercing capabilities make it a deadly choice against both mutants and heavily armed foes, though limited magazine capacity and slower firing rate require careful shot placement.

A perfect tool is the first thought that comes to mind when examining this Vintorez, tailored to excel in a specific range of tasks where silence is paramount.
sid_items_Gun_Sotnyk_AR_description:
Also known as the 'Vulcan', the Malyuk is a modern Ukrainian bullpup assault rifle prized for its compact design and versatility, offering excellent maneuverability without sacrificing firepower or accuracy. Its ergonomic design and integrated suppressor compatibility make it a favorite among stalkers who value stealth and adaptability. While its reduced length excels in tight spaces, its solid performance ensures reliability in a variety of combat scenarios.

Degtyarev’s personal assault rifle is truly a universal soldier among weapons, equally effective against the most ferocious mutants and the most experienced enemy combatants.
sid_items_Gun_Sharpshooter_AR_descriptio:
Origin: Germany
Manufacturer: Heckler & Koch

Developed for United States special operations forces as a major product improvement of the M4, the HK416 uses the proprietary gas piston system found on the G36 and therefore does not introduce propellant gases and carbon fouling back into the weapon’s interior, making it the most reliable of any M4/M16 type weapons. The rifle has been combat-proven and has rightfully gained worldwide attention of military and law enforcement.

An experiment to convert an assault rifle into sort of a sniper carbine — surprisingly successful despite the limitations of its ammunition.
sid_items_Gun_Trophy_AR_description:
Origin: Ukraine
Manufacturer: Krasilov Aggregate Plant

Engineered for Soviet special operations units, the AS Val is a gas operated, integrally suppressed weapon that was set to supersede the AK-47 and AKM rifles. It is easily disassembled and concealed, lightweight and comfortable to fire with the suppressor reducing bullet velocity to below subsonic levels. Today, the AS VAL sees widespread use among Russian special forces.

An ordinary stalker acquired this special assault rifle in a battle with a certain veteran mercenary. It seems all that experience couldn’t spare the merc from an early grave.
sid_items_Gun_Predator_SG_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Remington

A robust and reliable pump-action shotgun prized for its stopping power in close-quarters combat. It excels at taking down mutants or heavily armored opponents at short range. Its simple, durable design makes it highly dependable even in the harsh conditions of the Zone. While limited by a slower rate of fire and reduced effectiveness at longer distances, the M870’s sheer power and versatility make it an essential tool for stalkers venturing into dangerous, confined areas.

Formerly belonging to Trapper, this custom-built pump-action shotgun was designed to meet the owner’s specific request for a significant boost in lethality.
sid_items_Gun_Sledgehammer_SG_descriptio:
Origin: Italy
Manufacturer: Franchi

A dual-mode shotgun designed for combat and anti-riot measures, the SPAS-12 is employed by many special military and police units around the world. With its distinctive heat shield and folding stock, it is an iconic firearm, notable for its reliability and tactical flexibility. Despite its heavy weight, complex mechanisms and considerable cost, it remains a tried-and-true choice.

A custom modification of an Italian shotgun, made for a famous stalker. This firearm combines high damage with a surprisingly decent rate of fire for a shotgun.
sid_items_Gun_Texas_SG_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Standard Manufacturing

A double-barrel pump-action shotgun designed for unmatched close-range firepower in the Zone. Capable of firing two consecutive shots before cycling, it delivers devastating damage against mutants and enemies in confined spaces. While heavier than traditional shotguns and requiring practice to master its dual-barrel action, the DP-12 is a favorite for stalkers who demand maximum stopping power in high-risk encounters.

A true embodiment of Texan gun culture, this weapon is heavy, expensive, powerful, and absolutely merciless.
sid_items_Gun_Rail_SG_description:
Origin: USSR
Manufacturer: Tula Arms Plant (TOZ)

Intended for professional and amateur hunting, the TOZ-34 is an over/under double-barreled shotgun that acquired the state quality mark of the USSR. It is heavy, dependable and packs a punch.

Features a rifled barrel, enhancing its performance with slugs, but precluding the use of buckshot. The end result is akin to a handmade elephant gun, crafted with the purpose of hunting Pseudogiants.
sid_items_Gun_FDensity_MG_description: An overseas import to the Zone, this machine gun features a somewhat antiquated design complemented by modern accessories.
sid_items_Gun_Redemption_MG_description: Handcrafted by Khors for the trader Quiet, this piece reflects the technician’s unwavering dedication to his work. The weapon has undergone significant improvements in all characteristics, notably addressing the renowned reliability issues often found in machine guns of this series.
sid_items_Gun_Tank_MG_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Degtyaryov Plant

A light machine gun developed in the Soviet Union by Vasily Degtyaryov, created as a replacement for the DPM light machine gun. The new open bolt, gas operated, striker fired RPD was, at the time, 10 pounds lighter than any other weapon of its kind in service and used a cartridge that produced significantly less recoil under automatic fire. In the Zone, its primary use is assaulting buildings and eliminating groups of mutants.

A fusion of light machine gun and tank machine gun, this hybrid features a larger ammo box, a heavy barrel, and a lightweight bolt. The cost of improved reliability, extended range, and increased rate of fire is the substantial uptick in overall weight.
sid_items_Gun_Lynx_SR_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

One of the most iconic sniper rifles despite not technically being a sniper rifle, the SVD was intended to provide precise, suppressive fire on enemy positions as well as pick off high value targets. However, this squad-level DMR was eventually pressed into service as a sniper by those with access to nothing else. Relatively light, precise and well-balanced, it unfortunately loses out to dedicated sniper rifles in performance.

This rifle boasts a unique modification, handcrafted by a now-deceased master. The addition of a new barrel with a custom twist rate has notably improved accuracy and damage, though it appears to have seen little use of late.
sid_items_Gun_Partner_SR_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Springfield Armory

A semi-automatic marksman rifle known for its reliability and precision in long-range engagements. It delivers high stopping power and exceptional accuracy, making it a favored weapon for stalkers facing distant threats. Its robust construction and powerful cartridge allow it to penetrate armor and neutralize targets effectively. Though lacking the rate of fire of fully automatic rifles, the M1A’s range and precision make it an excellent choice for sharpshooters in the Zone.

This well-worn M1A rifle is fitted with a collimator sight, indicating the owner’s desire to gain an edge in firefights at short and medium range.
sid_items_Gun_Whip_SR_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: KBP Instrument Design Bureau

A compact and precision-engineered sniper rifle tailored for stealth and versatility. It offers exceptional accuracy and stopping power while its bullpup design ensures a lightweight and maneuverable profile. The SVU excels in mid-to-long-range engagements, making it a prized weapon for stalkers seeking silent precision against both mutants and hostile factions.

This rifle has replaced the Lynx in the hands of the finest Monolith sniper. It’s rare to find a rifle that excels in both rate of fire and accuracy, but this one defies the norm.
sid_items_Gun_Cavalier_SR_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Remington Arms

Often regarded as the number one bolt-action of all time, the Model 700 is a top choice for many military and law enforcement officers. With unequalled precision paired with unmatched build quality and reliability, it remains an industry leader to this day though its design is almost 6 decades old. While its bolt-action mechanism limits its rate of fire, the M700's unparalleled accuracy makes it an essential tool for stalkers who prefer to pick off threats before they get too close.

The owner must have watched too many documentaries on early 20th-century military conflicts, leading to a desire to own a modern reinterpretation of a bolt-action cavalry carbine.
sid_items_GunGauss_Scar_SP_description: A unique modification of the gauss cannon. It was designed specifically to disable electrical appliances, but it can also harm living creatures by affecting the target's nervous system.
sid_items_GunPM_HG_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Izhmash

This Soviet legacy is one of the best compact self-defense handguns available. Small, highly reliable, easy to use and easy to maintain, the Pistol Makarova was selected because of its simplicity, easy manufacturing, accuracy and reasonable stopping power. Unfortunately, though, it loses out to modern pistols in its class in terms of weight, magazine size and general performance.

sid_questItemprototypes_EQ75AK74_descrip: An AKS-74N recovered from a trench near the Slag Heap.
sid_questItemprototypes_EQ65AK74_descrip: A customized AKS-74U outfitted with a suppressor and a collimator sight. Few of the loners haunting the Cordon can afford a gun like this.

Its lightweight and ergonomic construction make it ideal for stalkers who need a versatile and dependable weapon for various encounters, from firefights with bandits to mutant threats in harsh environments.

Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Degtyaryov Plant

A modernized and improved version of the PK, the PKM's upgrades were primarily aimed at reducing weight, facilitating easier operation and simplifying production. A very reliable machine gun that remains in use as a front-line infantry and vehicle-mounted weapon with Russia's armed forces. Combining the formidable firepower of a heavy machine gun with the portability of an assault rifle, this weapon excels at eliminating entire groups of enemies.
sid_items_GunObrez_SG_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Tula Arms Plant (TOZ)

A break-action, double barrel shotgun intended for amateur hunting and general civilian use. The barrels and stock have been manually shortened to make the weapon lighter and more compact. Though quick to wield, its range and accuracy suffers but it is a devastating close-range weapon, nonetheless.
sid_items_GunTOZ_SG_description:
Origin: USSR
Manufacturer: Tula Arms Plant (TOZ)

Intended for professional and amateur hunting, the TOZ-34 is an over/under double-barreled shotgun that acquired the state quality mark of the USSR. It is heavy, dependable and packs a punch.
sid_items_GunM860_SG_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Remington

A robust and reliable pump-action shotgun prized for its stopping power in close-quarters combat. It excels at taking down mutants or heavily armored opponents at short range. Its simple, durable design makes it highly dependable even in the harsh conditions of the Zone. While limited by a slower rate of fire and reduced effectiveness at longer distances, the M870’s sheer power and versatility make it an essential tool for stalkers venturing into dangerous, confined areas.
sid_items_GunSPSA_SG_description:
Origin: Italy
Manufacturer: Franchi

A dual-mode shotgun designed for combat and anti-riot measures, the SPAS-12 is employed by many special military and police units around the world. With its distinctive heat shield and folding stock, it is an iconic firearm, notable for its reliability and tactical flexibility. Despite its heavy weight, complex mechanisms and considerable cost, it remains a tried-and-true choice.
sid_items_GunD12_SG_description:
Origin: South Africa
Manufacturer: Hilton R. Walker

A 12-gauge combat shotgun recognizable by its Kalashnikov design, intended for engaging targets at short range or in confined spaces. Known for its effectiveness and lethality, it has replaced the Armsel Protecta for Russian riot control and infantry combat.
sid_items_GunRam2_SG_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Standard Manufacturing

A double-barrel pump-action shotgun designed for unmatched close-range firepower in the Zone. Capable of firing two consecutive shots before cycling, it delivers devastating damage against mutants and enemies in confined spaces. While heavier than traditional shotguns and requiring practice to master its dual-barrel action, the DP-12 is a favorite for stalkers who demand maximum stopping power in high-risk encounters.
sid_items_GunSVDM_SP_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Kalashnikov Concern

One of the most iconic sniper rifles despite not technically being a sniper rifle, the SVD was intended to provide precise, suppressive fire on enemy positions as well as pick off high value targets. However, this squad-level DMR was eventually pressed into service as a sniper by those with access to nothing else. Relatively light, precise and well-balanced, it unfortunately loses out to dedicated sniper rifles in performance.
sid_items_GunMark_SP_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Springfield Armory

A semi-automatic marksman rifle known for its reliability and precision in long-range engagements. It delivers high stopping power and exceptional accuracy, making it a favored weapon for stalkers facing distant threats. Its robust construction and powerful cartridge allow it to penetrate armor and neutralize targets effectively. Though lacking the rate of fire of fully automatic rifles, the M1A’s range and precision make it an excellent choice for sharpshooters in the Zone.
sid_items_GunM701_SP_description:
Origin: United States
Manufacturer: Remington Arms

Often regarded as the number one bolt-action of all time, the Model 700 is a top choice for many military and law enforcement officers. With unequalled precision paired with unmatched build quality and reliability, it remains an industry leader to this day though its design is almost 6 decades old. While its bolt-action mechanism limits its rate of fire, the M700's unparalleled accuracy makes it an essential tool for stalkers who prefer to pick off threats before they get too close.
sid_items_GunSVU_SP_description:
Origin: Russia
Manufacturer: KBP Instrument Design Bureau

A compact and precision-engineered sniper rifle tailored for stealth and versatility. It offers exceptional accuracy and stopping power while its bullpup design ensures a lightweight and maneuverable profile. The SVU excels in mid-to-long-range engagements, making it a prized weapon for stalkers seeking silent precision against both mutants and hostile factions.
sid_items_GunRpg7_GL_description:
Origin: Soviet Union
Manufacturer: Degtyaryov Plant

Considered as one of the most successful anti-tank grenade launchers ever made, the RPG-7 is a shoulder fired, single shot, smoothbore launcher. Grenades are loaded from the front with the rear of the barrel using a venturi nozzle to make the weapon nearly recoilless.
sid_items_GunGauss_SP_description:
Origin: Redacted
Manufacturer: Redacted

A highly experimental, extremely accurate, artifact-powered weapon made by an unknown party in the Zone. Instead of gunpowder, the gauss rifle utilizes electromagnetic forces to launch projectiles at incredible speeds similar to a railgun. Proportionate to its tremendous firepower, the recoil is surprisingly controllable. Among other weapons of its class, its accuracy and firepower are unmatched.
sid_items_GunRPD_MagIncreased_descriptio: An extended-capacity ammo box for the RPD infantry machine gun. Perfect for when you need to suppress an entire platoon of enemies.
sid_items_GunRPD_MagLarge_description: Designed for the tank-mounted variant of the RPD, this ammo box provides a significantly larger ammunition capacity — enough to suppress all the bandits in Garbage.
sid_items_GunPKP_MagIncreased_descriptio: A large-capacity ammo box used with the PKM light machine gun. It's primarily intended to be used from stationary firing positions, but there’s nothing stopping you from taking on a Pseudogiant with it.
sid_items_GunPKP_MagLarge_description: An ammo box used with the PKT tank-mounted model, but equally suitable for the PKM light machine gun variant. Its ammunition capacity is simply mind-blowing.
sid_items_SS_PGO7Scope_description: An optical scope designed to magnify the effective range and accuracy of the RPG-7 rocket-propelled grenade launcher.
sid_items_RU_GLaunch_1_description: A Soviet-designed under-barrel grenade launcher, renowned for its reliability and simplicity. It fires 40mm grenades with devastating accuracy, making it ideal for clearing entrenched enemies or fortified positions. Compact and durable, it integrates seamlessly with most AK-pattern rifles.
sid_items_EN_GLaunch_1_description: Standardized in NATO countries, the M203 is a product of mid-twentieth-century conflicts, compatible with a wide range of Western rifles. Firing 40mm grenades, its rugged construction and ease of use make it ideal for tactical engagements, balancing firepower with precision for dynamic encounters.
sid_items_EN_GLaunch_2_description: An underbarrel grenade launcher designed exclusively for the G36 rifle platform. Firing 40mm grenades, it delivers precise explosive firepower for neutralizing enemies and clearing fortified positions. Its streamlined integration with the G36 ensures minimal impact on maneuverability and balance.
sid_items_EN_BuckLaunch_1_description: The M26 Modular Accessory Shotgun System (MASS) is a unique attachment that functions as a compact shotgun. Mounted under a rifle, it provides a secondary option for close-quarters combat with its devastating spread. Its modular design allows for quick reloads and adaptability to a variety of combat situations.
